_about: The formula checks (order 14, planner 25 Nov 2026, item 3): each limit a HELD standard states in numbers, with the clause's own sentence (`probe`, a regex found on a page of a rule book the review carried), the label keys of the two paper values it compares (the best first), and the rule that proves Met / Not met: [operator, k] means `left <op> k * right`; k may be "factor" (the number the clause sentence states) or "percent" (that number / 100). The standard's name is read from the carried book, never written here. Edit here, not in code.

checks.title: Design pressure covers the operating pressure
checks.probe: each element of a pressure vessel shall be designed for at least the most severe condition of coincident pressure
checks.words: the stated design pressure {a} is {rel} the operating pressure {b}

checks.title: Design temperature covers the operating temperature
checks.probe: the maximum temperature used in design shall be not less than the mean metal temperature
checks.words: the stated maximum design temperature {a} is {rel} the operating temperature {b}

checks.title: Relief set pressure against the MAWP
checks.probe: set to open at higher pressures but in no case at a pressure higher than (?:105|110)\s*% of the maximum allowable working pressure.{0,400}?marked set pressure shall not exceed (?P<factor>110)\s*% of the maximum allowable working pressure
checks.words: the stated set pressure {a} is {rel} the maximum allowable working pressure {b}

checks.title: Hydrostatic test pressure against the MAWP
checks.probe: hydrostatic test pressure that at every point in the vessel is at least equal to (?P<factor>1\.3|1\.5) times the maximum allowable working pressure
checks.words: the stated test pressure {a} is {rel} the minimum test pressure of {f} times the maximum allowable working pressure {b}
